name: How long does it take to paint a typical rental apartment?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a typical rental apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to paint a rental apartment varies depending on its size, the number of rooms, the extent of prep work needed, and the number of painters on the team. A standard one-bedroom apartment with minimal repairs might take 1-2 days for interior painting, including prep and drying time. Larger units, or those requiring extensive wall repair or multiple coats, could take 3-5 days or more. Your painting contractor can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing the specific conditions of your rental property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a rental apartment typically takes 1-2 days for a one-bedroom unit, or 3-5+ days for larger units or those needing extensive repairs.
